name: OSPD Process Profiles
abstract:
OGC API - Processes profiles for the deployable CWL processes of the OSPD 2026 reference
workflows (W1 Algae Bloom, W2 KindGrove mangrove biomass), each linked to its CWL source,
the generic provenance profile, the EOAP CWL custom types and the openEO Building Blocks.

bblocks.name: Process type register entry
bblocks.abstract: Candidate entry for the OSPD process-type register (Activity 4), linking a process profile, its six-phase position, its provenance class and its proposed openEO equivalences.
